description: This PHP class 'EmployeeAttachmentDecorator' is a decorator for the EmployeeAttachment entity in the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to retrieve attachment details and associated metadata.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for EmployeeAttachment entity, providing additional functionalities for handling employee attachment data including formatting dates, times, and managing associated employee records.

methods.name: getAttachedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted date when the attachment was added.

methods.name: getAttachedTime
methods.description: Returns the formatted time of attachment.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the attachment based on employee number.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves the content of the attachment as a string.
